verdict.rationale: Datalab documents processing limits and tells users to split oversized documents into segments with the page_range parameter, so thousand-page inputs need manual chunking rather than being handled natively. Async webhook notifications reduce the need for long-held polling connections, and one community user reports a successful run on a full book. missing for 10: native handling of thousand-page and multi-GB files without manual page_range splitting, documented behavior guaranteeing no silent truncation, stated size and page limits, independent evidence of reliable large-file processing at scale.
